A_tight.formula: max_cut + ceil(log2(e*N/k)); N = M*N_V; k = s*q*N
A_tight.note: the validated population (relation VUs + per-RU-copy input units) across M requests, each unit acquired with its RU at probability q and then sampled at s; e*N/k = e/(s*q) so the table is identical on the N_V_relation basis

interior_bytes_per_RU.includes: outgoing interface words of every request-local relation VU at actual widths (S.out of the unit)
interior_bytes_per_RU.excludes: weight inputs (prescribed; referenced from the registered commitment, never recommitted); the request's prompt-token and seed inputs and its served output tokens (committed at serve time)
interior_bytes_per_RU.note: served output tokens are produced by request-local VUs and so are inside `bits`; they are < 1e-6 of it and are not subtracted
interior_bytes_per_RU.verified_by_L5_A1: words/bits re-summed from the relation families only (every Input[...] family excluded): equal to the emitted values; weights and request inputs were never inside this volume
